description: Python translation of the chapkit CHAP-EWARS model: the same Bayesian hierarchical negative-binomial model with distributed-lag climate covariates, with dlnmpy in place of R dlnm and an INLA-style Laplace approximation written in Python in place of R-INLA. Modified version of the World Health Organization (WHO) EWARS model.
